verses.1: And there was a man among the Pharisees, whose name was Nikodemus; he was the leader of the Jews.
verses.2: This man came to him at night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you have been freed from God’s control as a teacher. No one else could do what you do, unless God himself was with you.”
verses.3: Jesus replied to him, “I tell you, if anyone is born from above, he will not see the kingdom of God.”
verses.4: Nikodemus says to him, “How can a person be born when they are already old? Can’t they go into their mother’s womb again and give birth?”
verses.5: Jesus replied, “I tell you truly, if anyone is not born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom of God.”
verses.6: What is born from the flesh is flesh; and what is born from the spirit is spirit.
verses.7: Do not be amazed that it was said to you that you were born from above.
verses.8: The breath goes wherever it wants, and you can hear its sound. But you don’t know where it comes from or how it moves. In the same way, every person who is born from the breath is also born from the breath.
verses.9: Nikodemus replied to him, “How can such things happen?”
verses.10: Jesus replied to him, “Are you indeed the teacher of Israel, and do you not understand these things?”
verses.11: Indeed, I tell you that what we know, what we have said, and what we have witnessed, you do not accept as true.
verses.12: If I say these things to you, and you still don’t believe me, then how can you believe in the air if I tell you those things?
verses.13: And no one can ascend to heaven unless they are the one who comes down from heaven—the Son of Man.
verses.14: And just as Moses raised the rock in the desert, so too must the son of man be raised.
verses.15: That everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.
verses.16: For thus loved the Lord the world, that He gave His Son as a single-begotten Son, so that everyone who believes in Him will not be killed but will have eternal life.
verses.17: For the Lord did not send His Son into the world to judge the world, but to save the world through Him.
verses.18: He who believes in Him does not judge; but he who does not believe already is judged, because he has not believed in the name of the only Son of God.
verses.19: This is the judgment that light has spread throughout the world, and people have preferred darkness to light, since darkness was their evil work.
verses.20: For every wicked person, light is hated. He doesn’t come near light, so that his actions won’t be controlled by it.
verses.21: And he who reveals the truth comes before the light, so that his works may be revealed as being done by God.
verses.22: After that, Jesus and His disciples went to Judea. There, He taught with them and also baptized them.
verses.23: And John also baptized in Ainon, near Salim. There was plenty of water there, and people came and were baptized there.
verses.24: For John was indeed imprisoned in the prison.
verses.25: Therefore, there was a request from John’s disciples regarding purification. This request came along with the Jewish concerns related to purification.
verses.26: And we went to John and said to him, “Rabbi, you who were with me beyond the Jordan, you who I have testified to about, see here: he is baptizing, and everyone comes to him.”
verses.27: John replied, “No one can receive anything unless it is given to him from heaven.”
verses.28: You yourselves testify to me that I said: “I am not the Christ.” Instead, I am just a messenger sent before Him.
verses.29: He who has the girl is a lover of girls. But the friend of the girl, who listens to her, rejoices at the sound of her voice. This is the joy that fills me.
verses.30: That one must be increased in size, while I should be reduced in size.
verses.31: The one who comes from above is superior to all others. The one who comes from the earth also belongs to the earth; he speaks in a manner related to the earth. But the one who comes from heaven is indeed superior to all others.
verses.32: He who saw and heard this, no one else can accept his testimony.
verses.33: By accepting his testimony, he realized that the God was indeed true.
verses.34: For it was he whom the God sent to deliver the words of the God. He did not give away the breath in measure.
verses.35: The father loves his son, and he gives everything in his hands to him.
verses.36: He who believes in his son will have eternal life. But he who refuses to believe in his son will not see any life; instead, the anger of God will remain upon him.
